hard_constraints.local_scope: one non-reset divider RHS expression; preserve register timing, widths and parameter declarations

curriculum.focus: Generate one compatible token substitution inside a non-reset sequential RHS expression. Preserve parameters, widths, reset branches, clock edges and output registration. Prefer a different eligible public counter/threshold site; do not add guards or branches.
curriculum.adaptation: Use actual prior online public repairs to choose a distinct follow-up. Public success is provisional and is not proof of mastery or of performance on unseen tasks. Fewer than two public repair successes are recorded: keep this exercise single-fault.
curriculum.priority: Apply the feedback adaptation first; reduce complexity after a failed repair even when the scheduled focus suggests a later-stage combination.
curriculum.diversity: Across the five rounds, use at most one pure comparison-constant substitution. Use the same numeric value as the same mutation even if underscores, leading zeros or radix spelling differ. Choose mechanisms, not cosmetic edits; correct parentheses and compilation before considering a proposal. Respect all excluded implementations and the unchanged public admission tests.
curriculum.scope: Only public design, round schedule and prior online public observations; no exam answers, reference-arm outcomes or validation scores.
